pages.title: Thermal Capacitor
pages.text: Right-click any $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) to install. One per heater; consumed on use. The upgrade persists through reloads and cannot be removed.$(br2)Output increases by 50%, with whole-number room output. Open-camp warmth radius doubles. Inside sealed rooms, coverage follows room geometry; a capacitor adds power, not an instant room-temperature bonus.
Refined Acheronite (top/bottom), Thermal Cores (sides), and a Frostbitten Core (center). It costs an arm and a leg. But your arms won't have frostbite anymore, so there's that.

pages.title: Power and Control
pages.text: More power speeds warm-up. It does not raise the shared target. Automatic control and an $(l:heating/thermostat)ORSA Thermostat$(/l) regulate upgraded heaters normally.$(br2)In open camps, a basic heater reaches 14 blocks and a Diamond Heater 28 before exposure or frostmite penalties.$(br2)$(italic)Engineering proposed “Thermal Amplitude Redistribution Device.” Marketing won.$()
